title: Confined Space Job Safety Analysis
description: Free Confined Space Job Safety Analysis template for construction you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers project information, atmospheric testing results (before entry), job steps & hazard analysis.

Job Steps & Hazard Analysis

JOB STEPHAZARDS IDENTIFIEDPOTENTIAL CONSEQUENCERISK RATING (L x S)CONTROL MEASURES
1. Pre-Entry Planning & Permit-Unknown atmosphere
-Unexpected hazards
-Inadequate rescue plan		-Asphyxiation
-Explosion
-Drowning
-Engulfment		25 (VERY HIGH)-Complete permit
-Isolate energy sources
-Lockout/tagout all hazards
-Blank/blind lines
-Ventilate space
-Rescue plan in place
2. Atmospheric Testing-Toxic gases
-Flammable
-Oxygen deficiency
-Stratification		-Poisoning
-Explosion
-Asphyxiation		25 (VERY HIGH)-Calibrate monitor before use
-Test at multiple levels
-Continuous monitoring
-Document all readings
-Test after breaks
3. Entry Setup & Signage-Improper isolation
-Unauthorized entry
-Communication failure		-Entry without knowledge
-Unauthorized entry
-Rescue delay		20 (VERY HIGH)-Post signs at entrance
-Barricade entry area
-Attendant stationed outside
-Establish communication
-Test communication equipment
4. Entry & Work in Space-Atmosphere change
-Physical hazards
-Engulfment		-Emergency evacuation
-Entrapment
-Injury
-Death		20 (VERY HIGH)-Continuous monitoring
-Entrant wears harness with lifeline
-Maintain communication
-Follow work procedures
-Avoid single block entry
5. Attendant Duties-Leaving post
-Distraction
-Multiple entrants
-Communication failure		-No rescue available
-Unable to account for all		25 (VERY HIGH)-Attendant never enters space
-Maintain continuous communication
-Monitor multiple entrants
-Keep rescue equipment nearby
-Summon rescue immediately
6. Emergency Rescue Procedures-Untrained rescuers
-Improper equipment
-Delayed response		-Failed rescue
-Multiple fatalities		25 (VERY HIGH)-Rescue team on standby
-Rescue equipment ready
-Practice rescue drills
-Never enter without training
-Contact emergency services
-Retrieval system attached
7. Exit & Closeout-Tools left inside
-Hazards not documented
-Permit not cancelled		-Hazards for next entry
-Subsequent incidents		8 (MODERATE)-Account for all personnel
-Remove all equipment
-Close and secure space
-Cancel permit
-Document lessons learned
